scope: Round 6. Only the requirements in SRS.txt: System - update goods table (buyer column), System - Searchbar function for transactions, Seller - Create new auction ('new' tag), Staff - Auction Management, Staff - Goods Management (incl. approval), Staff - Credit Management (incl. approval), System - Axios API call, Customer - Mail services (activation, forget password, change password via Gmail). Builds on rounds 1-5 (archived in progress-feature-list/). SRS 'All delete mean soft delete' applies to every delete in this round.

conventions.tests: Playwright e2e specs go in e2e/ as <id>-<slug>.spec.ts. Unit and API/integration tests use the existing vitest setup in be/tests/ as <area>.<topic>.test.ts; frontend unit tests sit next to the code (fe/src/**/*.test.ts) like the existing store tests. Every feature needs both kinds unless its verification list says otherwise.
conventions.change_docs: Each feature writes docs/changes/<id>.md listing the files it added or changed and why. Features with design decisions also add or update a topic doc under docs/, as named in their verification list.
conventions.soft_delete: Delete never removes rows. Use a status value ('deleted') or a deleted_at column, hide soft-deleted rows from normal lists, and keep them visible to staff with a filter.
conventions.status_mapping: Spec 'new' auction = schema status 'upcoming' (same mapping as round 2). Spec 'close' = 'ended'.
conventions.run_all: ./init.sh (npm install + npm run verify = vitest + fe build + Playwright) must exit 0 before a feature moves to passing. Stop running Docker containers / dev servers first (CLAUDE.md), otherwise prisma generate hits EPERM.
conventions.existing_tests: When a feature changes behaviour that an older test or spec checks (goods approval, credit approval, api client), update that test or its fixtures to check the new behaviour. Do not delete or weaken it.

status_legend.in_progress: The feature is the current active task.
status_legend.blocked: Work cannot continue until a documented blocker is resolved.
status_legend.passing: Required verification has passed and evidence is recorded.

roles.customer: A signed-in user who bids, tops up credit and receives account emails.
roles.seller: A customer acting as a seller: owns goods and auctions. Same users.role value 'customer'. After gds-003 a buyer who won goods can also re-auction them as their seller.
roles.staff: users.role 'staff'. Manages auctions, goods and credit through permission codes (be/src/lib/permissions.ts).

features.srs_ref: System - update goods table, Req-1, Req-2 (Highly Priority)
features.title: Goods get a nullable buyer column, set when a customer wins; re-auctioning moves buyer to seller
features.user_visible_behavior: When an auction ends with a winner, the goods row records that winner as buyer. The goods then appear in the buyer's My Goods as 'Bought' and the buyer can put them up for auction again; the original seller sees them as 'Sold' and can no longer auction them. If the buyer re-auctions the goods and another customer wins, the goods' seller becomes the previous buyer and the buyer becomes the new winner. An auction that ends with no winner, or is cancelled, leaves buyer unchanged.

features.title: Frontend calls the API through a shared Axios instance
